category_edits.rationale: Strengthen training-frequency attenuation across all four datasets to reduce common-item dominance in historical inputs. Retain the checkpoint-backed frequency feature, zero padding and unchanged candidate embeddings. The generated predictor imports this model class, so inference uses the same attenuation without changing checkpoint shapes.

change_summary: Increase historical input frequency attenuation from 0.3 to 0.5 for all four category models; preserve topology, readout, loss, optimizer, routing and training settings.
